lines.zh: 我走路的姿势，和你一样
lines.en: I walk with your gait.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀往哪边偏，我也偏
lines.en: However your shoulder leans, mine leans too.
I stay behind the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 你走几步，我的影子就补几步。
lines.en: Each step you take, my shadow fills in one more.

lines.zh: 路面上的脚印，只有一串
lines.en: Only one set of prints on the road.

lines.zh: 我不说话，走路也没声音
lines.en: I say nothing, and my steps make no sound.
However fast you walk, I keep that pace.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，别看得太快
lines.en: When you turn, don't look too quickly.
I walked this road before you.
I imitate it well, don't I?
You look back, and I step back half.

lines.zh: 我和你之间，隔着一整段路
lines.en: Between us there's a whole stretch of road.

lines.zh: 我站着的样子，和你一样
lines.en: I stand the way you stand.
I'm waiting for you to get farther ahead.

lines.zh: 我手里没有东西，可手里也该有
lines.en: My hands are empty, and they shouldn't be.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸节奏，我学过了
lines.en: I've learned your breathing.
I stay still because you're the one moving.

lines.zh: 我脸上没有表情，这不重要
lines.en: My face holds nothing; it doesn't matter.
You're wondering what I'm thinking.
When this stretch ends, we arrive.

lines.zh: 我一直跟着，你从没看清
lines.en: I've followed all along, and you've never seen clearly.
You have two shadows now.

lines.zh: 别停下来，停下来我就靠近
lines.en: Don't stop; stop and I come closer.
There's no need for words between us.
You're counting breaths; so am I.
I'm behind you, the whole way.

lines.zh: 你不用回头，回头也一样
lines.en: No need to look back; it's the same either way.

lines.zh: 你的搭档走远了，我才出现。
lines.en: Only when your partner is far do I appear.

lines.zh: 我的脸上，没有你的表情
lines.en: This face has none of your expressions.

lines.zh: 我是另一个你，没有声音
lines.en: I'm the other you, without a voice.

lines.zh: 你身边的每个人，我都见过
lines.en: I've seen everyone around you.
Don't ask my name.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我就进了一步
lines.en: You stepped back, so I stepped forward.

lines.zh: 你刚才是不是觉得有人跟着
lines.en: Didn't you feel someone following?

lines.zh: 我不会笑，这一点不像你
lines.en: I can't smile, and that's where we differ.
After you turn, I'm still watching.

lines.zh: 我们之间没什么好谈的
lines.en: There's nothing to discuss between us.

lines.zh: 你身后那一段路，我走过了
lines.en: That stretch behind you, I've walked it.

lines.zh: 你压低声音说话，我听不见
lines.en: You whisper, and I can't hear.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着灯，我的手上没有影子
lines.en: You hold a lantern; my hand casts no shadow.

lines.zh: 你看清我的时候，就晚了
lines.en: When you see me clearly, it's late.
Let's come a bit closer.

lines.zh: 这张脸和你一样，只是没有神
lines.en: This face matches yours, only without life.
That passed through, and I'm still here.
I have no sense of pain.
You didn't hit me.
I retreat, in your posture.

lines.zh: 你听见的是自己的声音
lines.en: What you heard was your own voice.
I tilted, then straightened.
Stop trying.
That one will leave your hand cold.
I've always been here.

lines.zh: 你不吃的东西，我也不吃
lines.en: What you don't eat, I don't eat.
Whatever you raise, I mimic.

lines.zh: 食物对你重要，对我不是
lines.en: Food matters to you, not to me.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我也放下空的
lines.en: You set yours down; I set down nothing.
I won't take it.

lines.zh: 你在递给谁，前面没有人
lines.en: Who are you offering it to? There's no one ahead.

lines.zh: 我学你的动作，学得很准
lines.en: I copy your movements, and precisely.

lines.zh: 这个动作你做过三次了
lines.en: You've made that gesture three times.
The more you relax, the closer I get.
Don't turn around to check.
You hit me like hitting air.

lines.zh: 我们擦肩的时候，你有感觉吗
lines.en: Did you feel it when we passed?

lines.zh: 我让开的距离，和你一样
lines.en: The distance I give matches yours.
You step back, I step back, the same count.

lines.zh: 我们撞到一起，只有一个影子
lines.en: When we met, there was only one shadow.
Don't reach out to touch me.

lines.zh: 你碰到的，可能是别人的衣服
lines.en: What you touched might be someone else's coat.
This time, I'm beside you.

lines.zh: 我们贴得很近，你却没看见
lines.en: We were very close and you didn't see.

lines.zh: 再近一点，你就分不清了
lines.en: Any closer and you won't tell us apart.

lines.zh: 我是复制出来的，没有这一项
lines.en: I'm a copy; I have no such thing.

lines.zh: 另一个玩家不在，只有我
lines.en: The other player isn't here, only me.

lines.zh: 两个人的距离够远，我才会出现
lines.en: I only appear when two are far apart.
I didn't come to pair.
You leave, and I follow.
You ask me; whom should I ask?
That question isn't for me.
I have nothing of my own.
Shadows don't seek partners.
Quiet, the road ahead is long.
What you pick up, I don't.
My hands hold nothing.

lines.zh: 我学你弯腰，但地上没东西
lines.en: I bend as you do, and there's nothing there.
What fell comes in only one.
You took it, so I'm empty-handed.
I reach out, and my hand is empty.
I've walked that patch of ground.

lines.zh: 捡吧，你手里的影子会少一份。
lines.en: Pick it up; your shadow will have one less.

lines.zh: 你抱着它，我也抱着看不见的
lines.en: You hold it; I hold something invisible.
Leave it there.
I see your back.
You've gone far enough.
Your pace is slowing.

lines.zh: 我知道你会在哪停下来
lines.en: I know where you'll stop.
The road bends ahead.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，是因为你走了
lines.en: I follow because you walked.
I'll see this stretch through with you.
The time has come.
Turn around.

lines.zh: 我看见你把手放下来了
lines.en: I saw you lower your hand.
You don't need to find anyone.
A little farther.
I've closed the distance.
Don't run; you can't escape.
The last stretch.
I'm at your shoulder.
Your shadow has stopped.
I begin counting: one, two.
Now, turn around.
You hesitated on this road.
I'm only a few blocks from you.

lines.zh: 你再往前，就是路的尽头
lines.en: Go further and you'll reach the road's end.
You've walked this stretch a long time.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，和你抬起的一样
lines.en: I raise a hand, the same as yours.
This one makes no sound.
You fell, and I stood.

lines.zh: 最后这一幕，只有你看见
lines.en: Only you see this final scene.
I have no face, yet I'm watching.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，只剩一个影子
lines.en: We press together and only one shadow remains.
The lamp went out.
I copied that one well.
It's over.
You're on the road, and so am I.
There's one more person behind you.

lines.zh: 我出现的地方，离你不远
lines.en: I appeared not far from you.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离刚刚好
lines.en: The distance between us is just right.
I got separated from the other one.
I'm a few blocks behind you.
There's one more shadow by the road.
I've followed you a long while.
You walk yours, I walk mine.
There's no one else around.

lines.zh: 我出现的时候，你没发现
lines.en: You didn't notice when I appeared.
One more stretch and we're there.
I only count as appearing when you look back.
I won't say the name.

lines.zh: 风里有个和我一样的影子
lines.en: There's a shadow in the wind like mine.

lines.zh: 火光照着我，我没有影子
lines.en: Firelight falls on me, and I cast no shadow.

lines.zh: 我落下去了，可没有声音
lines.en: I fell, without a sound.
Water scatters me slightly.

lines.zh: 爆炸过后，我还站在原位
lines.en: After the blast, I'm still in place.
The arrow went through.

lines.zh: 法术照出了我，也只是照出
lines.en: The spell revealed me, and only revealed.

lines.zh: 你饿的时候，我的嗓子也会发紧。
lines.en: When you go hungry, my throat tightens too.

lines.zh: 雷闪的一瞬，你看清我了
lines.en: In the lightning's flash, you saw me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有路，可我还跟着
lines.en: No road in the void, and I still follow.
